newsitem.title: PERU: Three Peru food firms seek bank help to merge.
newsitem.headline: Three Peru food firms seek bank help to merge.

text.p: Three Peruvian food firms planning a merger are looking for an international bank to take charge of weighing their assets, a stock notice said Wednesday.
The Lima market's daily report said Consorcio de Alimentos Fabril Pacifico, Nicolini Hermanos SA and Molinera del Peru, were seeing a bank of "known international prestige."
Under the merger plans, Fabril Pacifico, Peru's largest food company and owned by the powerful Romero group, would take over the other two companies.
The three firms' boards of directors are due to finalize the merger plans at the beginning of October.
